description: Machine-readable registry of the ten gates in the EFC adversarial review protocol (v2). One entry per gate; each names what must be proven, the primary reviewer role that supplies its evidence, and what counts as not_applicable. This is a data registry, NOT a JSON Schema — it is the single source of gate identities that claim_gate_matrix.json and efc_review_gate.py key on.
source: docs/validation-ledger/review-protocol.md § 'The ten gates' — the ten gate identities below mirror that enumeration verbatim (1 claim identity, 2 provenance, 3 formal validity, 4 model-relative validity, 5 paradigm declaration, 6 measurement chain, 7 proxy & bias audit, 8 regime/phase/domain, 9 discrimination & falsification, 10 reproduction + synthesis + human gate).

gates.name: claim_identity
gates.what_must_be_proven: the claim is stated with a claim_id, a single asserted proposition, and its source location

gates.name: provenance
gates.what_must_be_proven: source, version, DOI and ledger status are traceable and match the manuscript
gates.not_applicable_criterion: no external source or DOI is referenced

gates.name: formal_validity
gates.what_must_be_proven: mathematics is valid under the model's own premises
gates.not_applicable_criterion: claim carries no formal or derivational content

gates.name: model_relative_validity
gates.what_must_be_proven: the derivation holds within the model, without smuggled foreign premises

gates.name: paradigm_declaration
gates.what_must_be_proven: borrowed paradigms (LCDM, MOND, GR, EFC) are explicitly labelled

gates.name: measurement_chain
gates.what_must_be_proven: raw-signal to instrument to reduction to proxy to observable is decomposed step by step
gates.not_applicable_criterion: claim has no measurement or observable content

gates.name: proxy_bias_audit
gates.what_must_be_proven: INSTRUMENT/PROXY grounding carries an atlas_field pointing at the measurement chain
gates.not_applicable_criterion: no INSTRUMENT/PROXY evidence layer grounds the claim

gates.name: regime_phase_domain
gates.what_must_be_proven: the claim names its regime, phase and domain

gates.name: discrimination_falsification
gates.what_must_be_proven: a test against the raw signal, independent of the model's own assumptions, is specified
gates.not_applicable_criterion: claim is explicitly non-empirical (scope, provenance or status)

gates.name: reproduction_synthesis_human_gate
gates.what_must_be_proven: code/data chain reproduces and the meta-reviewer synthesis is closed (reproducer + meta_reviewer evidence); the human approval half is enforced SEPARATELY by human_gate.json beside the verdict, never by this matrix — a 'satisfied' here never counts as human approval
gates.not_applicable_criterion: none — this gate is always applicable for a release
